features.label: Softened volumes
features.explanation: Keep the original subjects’ three-dimensional volumes, softening edges and corners and simplifying small details
features.evidence: Roofs, towers and window frames retain clearly defined volumes, with some edges softened; trees and flower beds are simplified into rhythmic masses.
features.zh: 保持原有主体的三维体积，柔化边角并概括小细节
features.en: Keep the original subjects’ three-dimensional volumes, softening edges and corners and simplifying small details

features.label: Soft contours
features.explanation: Separate forms with soft but clear edges, reducing overly hard outlines
features.evidence: Roofs, towers and window frames retain clearly defined volumes, with some edges softened; trees and flower beds are simplified into rhythmic masses.
features.zh: 用柔和而清楚的边缘区分形体，减少过硬描边
features.en: Separate forms with soft but clear edges, reducing overly hard outlines

features.label: Warm yellow and blue-gray
features.explanation: Use a bright palette of warm yellow, blue-gray and restrained greens
features.evidence: Warm yellow stone walls, blue-gray roofs and blue sky form clearly separated areas; vegetation surrounds the architecture, and daylight is concentrated on the main subject.
features.zh: 使用暖黄、蓝灰与克制绿色的明快配色
features.en: Use a bright palette of warm yellow, blue-gray and restrained greens

features.label: Soft light and cast shadows
features.explanation: Build believable depth with soft daylight, form shading and contact shadows
features.evidence: Perspective, contact shadows and the shading of volumes establish depth; foreground leaves frame the view, and the main subject has a clear visual hierarchy.
features.zh: 用柔和日光、体块明暗和接触阴影建立可信深度
features.en: Build believable depth with soft daylight, form shading and contact shadows

features.label: Clear perspective
features.explanation: Keep the original viewpoint and perspective, reducing detail in secondary areas
features.evidence: Perspective, contact shadows and the shading of volumes establish depth; foreground leaves frame the view, and the main subject has a clear visual hierarchy.
features.zh: 保留原视角与透视，降低次要区域细节
features.en: Keep the original viewpoint and perspective, reducing detail in secondary areas

features.label: Hand-painted materials
features.explanation: Use simplified brushwork to distinguish materials, avoiding uniform fine noise
features.evidence: Stone walls, roof tiles and plants convey their materials through simplified color blocks and legible textures, avoiding a uniform covering of fine noise.
features.zh: 用概括笔触表现材质差异，避免均匀微噪声
features.en: Use simplified brushwork to distinguish materials, avoiding uniform fine noise

features.label: Warm fairy-tale mood
features.explanation: Create a warm, peaceful fairy-tale atmosphere with a handmade quality
features.evidence: The European-style manor, garden and soft sunlight combine into a warm, peaceful fairy-tale pastoral setting. Subject matter is not the same as a rendering method.
features.zh: 营造温暖宁静、有手工感的童话气质
features.en: Create a warm, peaceful fairy-tale atmosphere with a handmade quality

features.label: Keep the original palette
features.explanation: Keep the source image’s main hue relationships, adjusting only tonal values and contrast.
features.evidence: This is an optional creative variation, not a description of the reference artwork.
features.zh: 保留原图的主要色相关系，只调整色阶与对比
features.en: Keep the source image’s main hue relationships, adjusting only tonal values and contrast

avoid.zh: 不新增原图没有的人物、建筑、动物或道具；不复制参考图题字与水印；避免细节密度平均、材质噪声过重
avoid.en: Do not add people, buildings, animals or props absent from the source; do not copy reference lettering or watermarks; avoid uniform detail density and excessive texture noise
